parts.name: XIAO ESP32S3 Sense
parts.notes: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32S3 Sense (camera + mic + microSD expansion board included)

parts.name: Camera module
parts.notes: OV2640/OV3660/OV5640, included in the XIAO ESP32S3 Sense kit

parts.name: Silicone hook-up wire 28 AWG
parts.notes: 3 x 120 mm, PIR to XIAO pads; '28AWG silicone wire kit'

parts.name: USB-C cable 2 m
parts.notes: USB-A to USB-C, slim plug (< 12.5 x 7 mm overmould)

parts.name: USB 5V 1A wall adapter
parts.notes: UL listed 5V 1A USB charger; camera draws ~0.35 A

parts.name: Double-sided VHB tape
parts.notes: 0.25 mm thin VHB, two strips hold the front strip on the tube

parts.name: Aluminium tube
parts.notes: DMiotech 6061 round tube 45 mm OD x 42 mm ID x 300 mm (makes 2 bodies). Hacksaw to 145 mm, square and deburr the ends; using the printed front strip as a template, step-drill 2 x 12 mm holes (lens, PIR) and drill 2 x 2.9 mm screw holes at the back, 6 mm up from the bottom.

parts.name: M2.5×8 self-tapping screw for plastic
parts.notes: search: M2.5 x 8mm pan head self tapping screws for plastic
